surface_name: Scenario editor, Bigin by Zoho modules
title: Opening a CRM module in the Make editor shows a mapped lookup empty, and saving wipes it
symptoms: Contact ID renders empty with its Map toggle off
Contact ID: Value must not be empty
Records saved afterwards lose the contact link
cause: Some app modules, including the Bigin by Zoho update modules, do not render a mapped lookup value in the editor. Saving the module writes the empty field back.
fix: Do not edit these modules in the editor. Fetch the blueprint, change the mapper in code, and write it back through the API.
apply: GET /api/v2/scenarios/{id}/blueprint, edit flow[n].mapper, PATCH /api/v2/scenarios/{id} with {"blueprint": "<json string>"}, then POST /api/v2/scenarios/{id}/start
affected: Make Bigin by Zoho app (v2 modules), July 2026
